name: tiddlywiki-cloudflare
author: Théophile Desmedt (https://github.com/DesignThinkerer)
description: Host your own TiddlyWiki on Cloudflare's free plan: a worker for editing, R2 for storage, a public site served from the cache, and every save backed up to GitHub

WIKI_BUCKET.description: The R2 bucket that holds the wiki: the engine, the page, the tiddler list, one object per tiddler, the plugin files. Created as `wiki` unless you choose another name ([setup 2.2](https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/setup.md#22-the-bucket-and-the-public-site)); for a public site, give it a custom domain afterwards.

BACKUP_QUEUE.description: The queue that carries one message per save or delete to the GitHub backup, retried through outages and rate limits; the worker is its producer and its consumer. Created as `wiki-backup` ([setup 2.3](https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/setup.md#23-the-backup-queue)).
